name: Baseball Poker
summary: Seven-card stud poker variant where 3s and 9s are wild, 4s grant extra hole cards, and face-up 3s force a pot match.
rules_text: Baseball Poker is 7-card stud. Each player gets 1 down then 1 up, followed by a betting round, then three more up cards each with betting, finishing 1 down and 4 up. Nines and threes are wild. If a three is dealt face up, that player must match the current pot to stay or fold. If a four is dealt face up, that player immediately receives an extra hole card face down. After final betting, remaining players reveal all hole cards and make the best 5-card poker hand from their 7+ cards. Best hand wins the pot. Standard hand rankings apply, with five of a kind possible due to wilds.
